title: A skip link or landmarks let you go past the navigation bar
All navigation bar items work with the keyboard
Search and all filters work with the keyboard
You can fill in and submit the registration form with the keyboard
Course card buttons and table buttons (register / drop) work with the keyboard
The focus does not get stuck anywhere on the page
The focus order follows the visual order
The focus is always visible
The focused element is not hidden behind other content
note: header never fully covers the focused item

title: The focus goes into the modal when it opens
Tab and Shift+Tab stay in the modal while it is open
Esc and the close or cancel button close the modal
The focus goes back to the button that opened the modal
VoiceOver says that a dialog opened and reads its name
Each field has a visible label and VoiceOver reads it
Required fields are marked with text or a symbol that is explained (not color only)
An empty or wrong submit shows each error in text next to its field
Each error message tells how to correct it
VoiceOver reads the errors after submit
VoiceOver reads the result count after a search or filter change and the focus stays in place
VoiceOver reads the confirmation after you register or drop a course
Each page or view has a title that tells what it is
Headings: one h1 per view and levels in a logical order
Landmarks: banner or header and navigation and main and footer
Link and button names tell what they do
note: rotor: course buttons name their course

title: Meaningful images and icons have a text alternative and decorative ones are hidden
VoiceOver reads the column header for each cell of the registered-courses table
Dropdowns and toggles and tabs announce their role and state (for example expanded or selected)
The navigation bar tells which page is the current page
At 320 px width there is no horizontal scroll and no content is lost
note: all pages fit at 320 x 568, no sideways scroll

title: At 200% zoom all text is readable and nothing is cut off or on top of other content
note: no text cut off or overlapping at 200%

title: Errors and status and selected filters are not shown by color only
Focus indicators and field borders have a contrast of at least 3:1
note: lowest 5.2:1. Measured with CCA: nav link focus ring (yellow on dark header) 8.6:1; field focus ring on white 17.1:1; empty field border on white 5.2:1

title: The needs-review contrast sample passes (4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text)
note: measured with CCA: header 'Course Registration' 5.7:1; nav 'Course catalog' 7.8:1; home h1 13.4:1 (all pass)
